marks.gloss_en: דתניא: כל שנים עשר חדש גופו קיים ונשמתו עולה ויורדת... (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
אמריתו נשמתן של צדיקים גנוזות תחת כסא הכבוד -- אובא טמיא היכא אסקיה לשמואל בנגידא?
התם בתוך שנים עשר חדש הוה (= p_tokh_12_chodesh)
the min: [if so,] how did the necromancer bring up Samuel by necromancy?
ולאו אמר רב מרי: עתידי צדיקי דהוו עפרא? -- kind svara under protest: no kind for an amoraic-memra contradiction
ומני מרי דלא ידענא ליה? -- and who is Mari, whom I do not know? (a rebuff of the cited authority)
והא קרא כתיב: וישוב העפר על הארץ כשהיה! -- kind svara: no kind names a bare verse
diggers digging in Rav Nachman's land -- Rav Achai bar Yoshiya [buried there] snorted at them
דאקרייך קהלת לא אקרייך משלי: ורקב עצמות קנאה -- whoever has no envy, his bones do not rot (= p_ein_kina_ein_markivim)
Rav Achai: whoever has envy in his heart, his bones rot; whoever has no envy in his heart, his bones do not rot
והכתיב: כי עפר אתה ואל עפר תשוב! -- kind svara: no kind names a bare verse
ההוא שעה אחת קודם תחיית המתים (= p_shaa_achat_kodem_tchiya)
Rav Nachman: but it is written, 'for dust you are and to dust you shall return' (Gen 3:19)
a man died in Rav Yehuda's neighbourhood and had no comforters; every day Rav Yehuda would take ten and they sat in his place
R' Abbahu: everything said before the dead he knows, until the golel [grave-stone] is sealed
the one who said until the flesh decomposes -- for it is written: 'but his flesh upon him shall feel pain and his soul shall mourn over him' (Job 14:22)
'and the spirit returns to God who gave it' (Eccl 12:7) -- give it to Him as He gave it to you: in purity, so you too in purity
of the wise he said: let my garments go to the treasury and let them go home in peace; of the fools he said: let my garments go to the launderer and let them be shut in prison
so too the Holy One: of the bodies of the righteous He says 'he enters into peace, they rest on their beds' (Is 57:2)
R' Eliezer: the souls of the righteous are stored beneath the Throne of Glory
Rabba to Rav Nachman: what of [the souls of] the middling?
[Rav Nachman] felt him and saw that he had substance
